Dr. Rowe shows an amazing hip flexor pain relief exercise called the psoas cobra.

This stretching exercise will target tight hip flexors (including the psoas muscle), and may give muscle pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS.

It can be done at home and requires no equipment. 

Let us know how it works for you!
